title: Catalog record definition (sources / published targets)
description: Catalog FILE-store JSON for DV_SOURCE feeds and published model/ops tables. Column layout is always a structured fields[] list on the element that owns the layout — never a top-level Hop rowMetaXml blob on write.

namespace.description: Catalog namespace path, e.g. hop/{project}/sources or hop/{project}/models/{modelName}.

name.description: Logical name. For DV_SOURCE this is the recordSource name used in .hdv (e.g. CRM-customer).

type.description: Record type code. Layout home depends on type (see catalog-record-definition.md).

rowMetaXml.description: LEGACY READ-ONLY. Older catalogs stored Hop IRowMeta as XML here. Current plugin versions never write this field. On load, non-empty values are migrated into dvSource.fields (DV_SOURCE) or physicalTable.fields (targets/ops) and omitted on the next save. Do not hand-edit or reintroduce.

physicalTable.description: RDBMS location. For DV_SOURCE: location only (fields stay on dvSource). For published vault/BV/DM/ops tables: also holds authoritative column layout in fields[].

databaseMetaName.description: Hop DatabaseMeta connection name (e.g. CRM, Vault).

fields.description: Authoritative column layout when type is DV_HUB, DV_LINK, DV_SATELLITE, DV_REFERENCE, BV_TABLE, DIM_TABLE, FACT_TABLE, PHYSICAL_TABLE, or VIEW. Must be empty/absent for DV_SOURCE (use dvSource.fields).

physicalFile.description: File location for CSV/Parquet-style DV_SOURCE feeds. Location only; layout is on dvSource.fields.

physicalIcebergTable.description: Iceberg location for DV_SOURCE. Location only; layout is on dvSource.fields.

qualityRules.description: Optional data-quality rule bindings for this dataset.

dvSource.description: DV source binding for type=DV_SOURCE (and null for most published targets).

sourceType.description: DATABASE, CSV, PARQUET, ICEBERG, COMPOSITE, JSON, …

sourceIndicator.description: Optional static record-source value for every row.

fields.description: Authoritative field layout for DV_SOURCE only (types, PK, FK, CSV options).

sourceDataType.description: Hop type name (Integer, String, Timestamp, …) and/or native SQL label (int4, VARCHAR, DATETIME(6)).

length.description: Declared length as string; empty when not applicable.

precision.description: Scale / fractional seconds as string; empty when not applicable.

hopType.description: Hop value-meta type code: 2=String, 3=Date, 4=Boolean, 5=Integer, 1=Number, 6=BigNumber, 8=Binary, 9=Timestamp. Must not be 0 when the type is known.

primaryKeyPosition.description: 1-based PK position; 0 or omitted if not part of the key.

fkPosition.description: 1-based position within a composite FK; 0 if not part of an FK.

inputOptions.description: Optional per-field input options (e.g. CSV format/decimal/grouping).
